name: North America: New York State
court: NORTH AMERICA - UNITED STATES - NEW YORK STATE

outcome.intro: After studying this section, a student will understand the climate, climate moderators, and major grape varieties grown in New York State.
outcome.certified: After studying this section, a candidate will know the major AVAs and grapes varieties grown in New York State (including hybrids and other species). Certified Sommeliers will be able to recommend and sell food pairings with New York wines to a guest.

rows.certified: Hudson River AVA, Lake Erie AVA, Long Island AVA

rows.intro: Continental with moderating influences of lakes and rivers for inland areas and the Atlantic Ocean for coastal regions.
Must protect vines from deep freezes during harsh winters and from mold in the summer.
